categories.name: Snare
categories.summary: Face-down traps that spring when a foe does a particular thing. Your foe sees that a Snare is set, not which one.

categories.name: Ward
categories.summary: Face-up protections that stay on the field and wear down with use.

categories.name: Counter
categories.summary: Instant answers played from hand in response to a foe's move.

categories.name: Omen
categories.summary: Delayed effects. Set face-down with a round counter showing; it resolves on its own when the counter runs out.

categories.name: Gambit
categories.summary: Risky plays decided by a roll. High reward, real downside.

categories.name: Edict
categories.summary: Commands to your own beasts — swaps, rallies and focus.

categories.name: Rite
categories.summary: Powerful effects with a steep extra cost, such as discarding cards or HP.

categories.name: Lure
categories.summary: Tools for wild encounters, Bond Checks and vessel spirits.

categories.name: Talisman
categories.summary: Charms equipped to a beast or Keeper for a lasting effect.

categories.name: Memory
categories.summary: Cards that draw on the defeated and the discarded.

cards.name: Reed Pitfall
cards.trigger: A foe moves into melee range of one of your beasts.
cards.card_text: When a foe moves into melee with your beast, it falls Prone and its attack this turn has disadvantage.
cards.flavour: The reeds look solid. They are not.

cards.name: Bamboo Spring Snare
cards.card_text: When a foe declares an attack, it makes a DEX save (DC 14) or is Restrained for 1 round and the attack is lost.
cards.flavour: A bent bamboo pole, a loop of cord, and patience.

cards.name: Mirror Pool
cards.trigger: A foe uses a technique that forces a save.
cards.card_text: Reflect a save technique back at its user. It must save against its own DC.
cards.flavour: Look down, and see yourself attacking.

cards.name: Ink Cloud
cards.trigger: A foe declares an attack against one of your beasts.
cards.card_text: Before the roll, the target becomes Hidden. The attack must pass a Tracking check or miss.
cards.flavour: Borrowed from an Inkcarp who owed a favour.

cards.name: Ember Tripwire
cards.trigger: A foe tags in from the bench.
cards.card_text: The incoming beast takes 2d6 damage and is Burning for 2 rounds.
cards.flavour: Strung across the gate, invisible until it isn't.

cards.name: Undertow Net
cards.trigger: A foe ends its turn after moving 20 ft or more.
cards.card_text: The foe becomes Rooted and Soaked for 1 round.
cards.flavour: Fishermen's nets catch more than fish.

cards.name: Sealbreaker Knot
cards.trigger: A foe begins a seal chain.
cards.card_text: Every seal in the chain must pass a risk roll, not just those past the third.
cards.flavour: Tie the knot before they finish the seal.

cards.name: Hollow Gourd
cards.card_text: The healing is halved. One of your beasts regains the other half.
cards.flavour: What pours out of one gourd pours into another.

cards.name: Paper Charm Wall
cards.card_text: The first attack each round against your chosen beast has disadvantage. 3 charges; spend one each time.
cards.flavour: Brushed by a temple scribe, pasted with rice glue.

cards.name: Salt Circle
cards.card_text: Your beasts can't become Charmed or Frightened. Breaks when a foe scores a critical hit.
cards.flavour: Nothing unwelcome crosses salt.

cards.name: Lantern of Return
cards.card_text: The first time one of your beasts would drop to 0 HP, it drops to 1 instead. Then discard this.
cards.flavour: Light it for those who must come home.

cards.name: Watch Bell
cards.card_text: At the start of each round, all Hidden foes become Exposed. 2 charges.
cards.flavour: The bell rings when anything moves in the dark.

cards.name: Stone Ancestor
cards.card_text: Your active beasts gain +1 Guard. Lose a charge each time one of them is hit. 3 charges.
cards.flavour: The village guardian has stood here for five hundred years. It can stand a little longer.

cards.name: Turn the Tide
cards.trigger: A foe's attack hits one of your beasts.
cards.card_text: Force the attacker to reroll the attack and keep the new result.
cards.flavour: The current changes its mind.

cards.name: Broken Seal
cards.trigger: A foe uses a technique costing 3 or more Qi.
cards.card_text: Cancel the technique. Its Qi is still spent.
cards.flavour: One stroke out of place and the whole seal fails.

cards.name: Swift Exchange
cards.trigger: A foe targets one of your active beasts.
cards.card_text: Swap the target with one of your benched beasts. The new beast becomes the target.
cards.flavour: Not this one. Me.

cards.name: Last Gong
cards.trigger: One of your beasts drops to 0 HP.
cards.card_text: Before it leaves the field, the beast makes one attack or uses one technique it can pay for.
cards.flavour: The gong sounds once more after the hand has fallen.

cards.name: Echoing Rebuke
cards.trigger: A foe's Snare or Omen resolves.
cards.card_text: Negate that Snare or Omen and destroy it.
cards.flavour: We saw that coming.

cards.name: Red Sky at Morning
cards.card_text: In 2 rounds: replace the Field with the top Field card of your deck, or keep the current one.
cards.flavour: Shepherds and sailors both know what a red dawn means.

cards.name: Falling Star
cards.card_text: In 3 rounds: choose a foe. It takes 4d6 damage (DEX save DC 15 for half).
cards.flavour: Make a wish. Theirs won't come true.

cards.name: Ancestors' Visit
cards.card_text: In 2 rounds: return one defeated beast to your bench with half its HP. It no longer counts as defeated.
cards.flavour: The lanterns are lit for those who return.

cards.name: Harvest Moon Rising
cards.card_text: In 3 rounds: each of your active beasts heals 2d8 and gains 2 Qi.
cards.flavour: Wait for the moon. It always comes.

cards.name: Comet of Change
cards.card_text: In 2 rounds: one of your Kits or Adepts that meets the level requirement evolves without its item.
cards.flavour: Some nights, everything changes.

cards.name: Coin of Heaven and Earth
cards.card_text: Roll a d6. 4–6: your beasts deal +1d6 damage this turn. 1–3: your beasts take −2 Guard until your next turn.
cards.flavour: Square hole for earth, round coin for heaven.

cards.name: Fortune Sticks
cards.card_text: Roll a d6 and read your fortune: 1 lose 1 Qi from each beast · 2 discard a card · 3 nothing · 4 draw 1 · 5 heal 2d6 · 6 draw 2 and gain 1 Resolve.
cards.flavour: Shake the cup until one stick falls out.

cards.name: Kite in a Storm
cards.card_text: Roll a d20. 15+: choose the next Field from your deck and play it. 6–14: nothing. 1–5: discard your hand.
cards.flavour: Either it flies, or it's gone.

cards.name: All-In at the Ferry
cards.card_text: One beast spends all its Qi. Its next attack deals +1d8 per Qi spent. If it misses, it is Stunned for 1 round.
cards.flavour: The ferryman takes everything or nothing.

cards.name: Double or River
cards.card_text: Roll 2d6. Doubles: draw 3 cards. Otherwise draw 1 and discard 1.
cards.flavour: A market game older than the market.

cards.name: Rally Cry
cards.card_text: Each of your active beasts gains 1 Qi.
cards.flavour: Together!

cards.name: Fall Back
cards.card_text: Swap up to two of your active beasts with benched beasts. Leaving reach does not provoke.
cards.flavour: Live to fight the next round.

cards.name: Focus Fire
cards.card_text: Choose a foe. Your attacks against it gain +2 to hit this turn.
cards.flavour: That one. All of you.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.card_text: Until your next turn, your active beasts gain +2 Guard, can't move and can't be pushed or swapped.
cards.flavour: Not one step back.

cards.name: Read the Hour
cards.card_text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavour: A good Keeper knows what time it is.

cards.name: Rice and Salt Offering
cards.card_text: Discard 2 cards. One of your beasts heals to full HP and ends all conditions.
cards.flavour: The oldest offering is the simplest.

cards.name: River Lantern Rite
cards.card_text: When you release a vessel spirit, also end every condition on your beasts.
cards.flavour: Set it on the water and let it go, and let everything else go with it.

cards.name: Vigil of the Hour
cards.extra_cost: Your beast skips its next two turns.
cards.card_text: One Adept holding a Zodiac Seal makes its Ascension Roll now. On a success it becomes Sovereign.
cards.flavour: The Trial does not wait for convenient times.

cards.name: Name Binding
cards.extra_cost: One of your beasts takes 1d6 damage.
cards.card_text: Choose a foe. It can't be swapped or tagged out for 2 rounds.
cards.flavour: Speak its true name and it cannot leave.

cards.name: Incense for the Hours
cards.extra_cost: One of your beasts takes 1d6 damage.
cards.card_text: Gain 2 Resolve.
cards.flavour: Twelve sticks, one for each Hour.

cards.name: Rice Ball Lure
cards.card_text: Your next Bond Check this battle gains +2.
cards.flavour: The way to most hearts.

cards.name: Moonlight Bait
cards.card_text: Reveal cards from the wild deck until you find a vessel spirit. You may attempt to capture it now.
cards.flavour: Leave a bowl of milk in the moonlight and see what comes.

cards.name: Woven Fish Trap
cards.trigger: A Water or Frost vessel spirit appears.
cards.card_text: When a Water or Frost spirit appears, capture it automatically if you hold an empty Bamboo Creel.
cards.flavour: Set it in the evening, check it in the morning.

cards.name: Offering of the Favoured
cards.card_text: Name a beast's favoured offering. Your next Bond or Command Check with that beast has advantage.
cards.flavour: Every beast has something it cannot refuse.

cards.name: Jade Talisman
cards.card_text: Bond Checks you make are against DC −2.
cards.flavour: Carved from river jade and warmed in the palm.

cards.name: Element Shard
cards.card_text: A Kit at Level 16 or higher holding this may evolve into its Adept.

cards.name: Zodiac Seal
cards.card_text: An Adept at Level 36 or higher holding this may attempt the Trial of the Hour.

cards.name: Red Thread
cards.card_text: Tie two of your beasts together. Damage dealt to either is split evenly between them, rounding up on the target.
cards.flavour: The thread of fate stretches but never breaks.

cards.name: Bronze Mirror
cards.card_text: The first save technique targeting this beast each battle is reflected back at its user.
cards.flavour: Evil cannot bear to see its own face.

cards.name: Peach Wood Charm
cards.card_text: This beast can't become Frightened.
cards.flavour: Peach wood has warded off evil since before the first Hour.

cards.name: Gourd of Plenty
cards.card_text: This beast regains 1 extra Qi at the start of each of its turns.
cards.flavour: Always a little more inside than seems possible.

cards.name: Ancestral Tablet
cards.card_text: Choose a defeated beast of yours. One of your active beasts may use one of its techniques this turn, paying its Qi.
cards.flavour: The names on the tablet are never forgotten.

cards.name: Ash and Ember
cards.card_text: Return a Snare or Counter from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavour: What burned once can burn again.

cards.name: Return of the Swallows
cards.card_text: Shuffle up to 3 defeated beasts back into your deck. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavour: Every spring the swallows come back to the same eaves.
